# TYPE ftp_gateway_sessions_active gauge

# HELP ftp_gateway_uploads_active Number of STOR transfers currently in progress.
# TYPE ftp_gateway_uploads_active gauge

# TYPE ftp_gateway_pasv_ports_active gauge

# HELP ftp_gateway_pasv_ports_capacity Number of PASV/EPSV data ports in the configured range (capacity minus active is what is left).

ftp_gateway_pasv_ports_capacity 10

# TYPE ftp_gateway_sessions_total counter

# TYPE ftp_gateway_connections_rejected_total counter
ftp_gateway_connections_rejected_total 0
# HELP ftp_gateway_uploads_started_total Total STOR transfers that reached the Backend (both data connections up).

# HELP ftp_gateway_uploads_completed_total Total STOR transfers the Backend confirmed with a 2xx reply.

ftp_gateway_data_connections_rejected_total 0
# HELP ftp_gateway_backend_timeouts_total Total timeouts waiting on or connecting to a Backend.
# TYPE ftp_gateway_backend_timeouts_total counter
ftp_gateway_backend_timeouts_total 0
# HELP ftp_gateway_session_idle_timeouts_total Total control sessions closed for being idle too long.
# TYPE ftp_gateway_session_idle_timeouts_total counter
ftp_gateway_session_idle_timeouts_total 0
# HELP ftp_gateway_backend_source_unhealthy 1 if the source address is currently left out of the rotation after failing to connect.
# TYPE ftp_gateway_backend_source_unhealthy gauge
ftp_gateway_backend_source_unhealthy{source="127.0.0.1"} 0
